# Thirza Abernethy

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixty years old  <sub>[v3 c22 P3](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0003)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  <sub>[v4 c34 P1](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0001)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley  <sub>[v1 c8 P11](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0011)</sub>
- **Role:** Cook and homemaker  <sub>[v1 c16 P27](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0027), [v1 c27 P2](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0002)</sub>
- **Titles:** Miss Abernethy  <sub>[v1 c8 P11](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0011), [v4 c19 P0](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Thirza is a tall, slender woman with a lean frame and sharp angles. Her hair, which has silvered over the years, is bound tightly at the back in a firm bun held by wire hairpins. She has a pale face, lined cheeks, and rough, labor-calloused hands. Though her failing eyesight initially threatened total blindness, her vision stabilized in a state that left her unable to perform fine needlework or read extensively.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v2 c8 P3](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0003), [v2 c12 P39](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0039), [v2 c14 P4](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0004), [v2 c15 P43](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0043), [v3 c22 P2](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0002)_

## Personality

Thirza is a practical, matter-of-fact, and stern woman with an unyielding sense of morality and duty. She tends to be reserved, disciplined, and critical, preferring formal decorum and frugal living while holding a strong dislike for cats and fancy trimmings. Beneath her sharp, fault-finding exterior lies a deep capacity for love, subtle humor, and genuine selflessness. As she ages, her disposition becomes notably softer and more mellow.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c8 P41](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0041), [v1 c21 P26](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0026), [v1 c26 P1](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0001), [v1 c30 P3](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0003), [v1 c37 P20](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0020), [v1 c38 P46](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0046), [v2 c7 P31](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0031), [v3 c22 P2](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0002), [v3 c38 P9](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0009)_

## History

Thirza Abernethy lived for decades at Grey Shutters alongside her brother Obed. Expecting to adopt an orphan boy from an asylum, they were instead mistakenly sent Nell Harcourt, whom Thirza decided to raise despite her initial hesitation. Over the years, she managed the household, taught Nell homemaking skills, and maintained a strict but deeply affectionate upbringing. Following the sudden death of Obed, Thirza continued to run Grey Shutters and took in the orphaned Farrow twins, Robin and Lucy. She faced deteriorating eyesight, though medical care eventually prevented total blindness. After Nell grew up and married Hugh Carrow, Thirza traveled sixty miles to Seven Gulls for Christmas, marking her first journey of such distance. She later visited Nell to support her during the birth of her child.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P31](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0031), [v1 c6 P3](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0003), [v1 c6 P29](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0029), [v1 c30 P16](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0016), [v1 c37 P1](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0001), [v1 c37 P28](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0028), [v2 c7 P31](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0031), [v2 c14 P4](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0004), [v2 c14 P15](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0015), [v2 c15 P43](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0043), [v4 c1 P5](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0005), [v4 c15 P1](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0001), [v4 c19 P0](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0000)_

## Background by volume

- Inherited an amethyst brooch from her mother  <sub>[v1 c13 P20](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0020)</sub>
- Was close friends with John Carrow during youth  <sub>[v1 c37 P37](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0037)</sub>
- Overheard an aunt call her a dark, homely little thing in childhood  <sub>[v1 c9 P44](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0044)</sub>
- Moved to Grey Shutters upon reaching adulthood  <sub>[v1 c1 P31](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0031)</sub>
- Raised by her father to refrain from sending children to school before age seven  <sub>[v2 c10 P86](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0086)</sub>
- Lost her former Frost Maiden tree in a severe gale  <sub>[v3 c39 P10](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0010)</sub>
